## EMERGENCY DEPARTMENT PROVIDER NOTE
Arrival: 09/21/2026 23:40 via EMS (called by outreach worker)
## HPI
48 y/o M, unhoused, with alcohol use disorder, presents with severe epigastric pain radiating to back x 1 day, nausea, vomiting. Pt intoxicated on arrival. Reports drinking about 12 beers daily; last drink 09/21/2026 around 22:00.
## Exam
T 99.1F HR 112 BP 148/90 RR 20 SpO2 96% RA
Alert, smells of alcohol, slurred speech. Epigastric tenderness, no rebound. No jaundice.
## Data
BAL 228 mg/dL (09/22 00:10)
Lipase 1,240 U/L H, AST 88 H, ALT 46 H, T bili 0.9, Glu 138, Ca 9.0, TG 210
CT abdomen with contrast: acute interstitial edematous pancreatitis, no necrosis, no fluid collection; no gallstones; liver without cirrhotic morphology
## ED Course / MDM
Acute alcoholic pancreatitis and acute alcohol intoxication. IV fluids, IV analgesia, antiemetic. Admit to medicine with CIWA monitoring.
Signed: P. Lindqvist, MD 09/22/2026 03:55
